outcome: occurrence of hypoglycemia (<3.9 mmol/L and <3.0 mmol/L)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 168 children and young people (79 White, 61 South Asian, 28 Black) with type 1 diabetes who received structured education in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) use at a tertiary center.
finding: Children and young people from Black ethnic backgrounds with type 1 diabetes had significantly higher HbA1c and experienced more hypoglycemia compared to their South Asian and White counterparts, independent of mean blood glucose and socioeconomic status.
